inlines.text: A bakery bakes 18 loaves in 45 minutes.
Each loaf uses 600 g of flour.
What is the cost of flour per hour?
Quantities: cost, time, loaves and flour.

inlines.latex: \begin{align*}\frac{\text{Cost}}{\text{Time}}&=\frac{\text{Loaves}}{\text{Time}}\times\frac{\text{Flour}}{\text{Loaf}}\times\frac{\text{Cost}}{\text{Flour}}\\\frac{\$x}{1\text{ h}}&=\frac{18\text{ loaves}}{45\text{ min}}\times\frac{600\text{ g}}{1\text{ loaf}}\times\frac{\$1.40}{1\text{ kg}}\\\frac{\$x}{1\text{ h}}&=\frac{18\text{ loaves}}{\color{#ef6068}{(45\div60)}\text{ h}}\times\frac{\color{#ef6068}{(600\div1000)}\text{ kg}}{1\text{ loaf}}\times\frac{\$1.40}{1\text{ kg}}\\x&=24\times0.6\times1.40\\x&=20.16\end{align*}

content.prompt: Use the quantities given to find each rate.

children.label: a
children.prompt:
A truck travels 250 km in 150 minutes.
It uses 32 L of diesel per 100 km.
Diesel costs \$1.95 per litre.
What is the cost of diesel per hour?

answer.worked:
Quantities: cost, time, distance and diesel.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{\text{Cost}}{\text{Time}}&=\frac{\text{Distance}}{\text{Time}}\times\frac{\text{Diesel}}{\text{Distance}}\times\frac{\text{Cost}}{\text{Diesel}}\\\frac{\$x}{1\text{ h}}&=\frac{250\text{ km}}{150\text{ min}}\times\frac{32\text{ L}}{100\text{ km}}\times\frac{\$1.95}{1\text{ L}}\\\frac{\$x}{1\text{ h}}&=\frac{250\text{ km}}{(150\div60)\text{ h}}\times\frac{32\text{ L}}{100\text{ km}}\times\frac{\$1.95}{1\text{ L}}\\x&=100\times0.32\times1.95\\x&=62.40\end{align*}$$
The cost is $\$62.40/\text{h}$.

children.label: b
children.prompt:
A machine fills 60 bottles in 45 minutes.
Each bottle holds 250 mL of juice.
Juice costs \$3.20 per litre.
What is the cost of juice per hour?

answer.worked:
Quantities: cost, time, bottles and juice.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{\text{Cost}}{\text{Time}}&=\frac{\text{Bottles}}{\text{Time}}\times\frac{\text{Juice}}{\text{Bottle}}\times\frac{\text{Cost}}{\text{Juice}}\\\frac{\$x}{1\text{ h}}&=\frac{60\text{ bottles}}{45\text{ min}}\times\frac{250\text{ mL}}{1\text{ bottle}}\times\frac{\$3.20}{1\text{ L}}\\\frac{\$x}{1\text{ h}}&=\frac{60\text{ bottles}}{(45\div60)\text{ h}}\times\frac{(250\div1000)\text{ L}}{1\text{ bottle}}\times\frac{\$3.20}{1\text{ L}}\\x&=80\times0.25\times3.20\\x&=64\end{align*}$$
The cost is $\$64/\text{h}$.

children.label: c
children.prompt:
A tractor ploughs 12 hectares in 90 minutes.
It uses 18 L of diesel per hectare.
How much diesel does it use per hour?

answer.worked:
Quantities: diesel, time and area.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{\text{Diesel}}{\text{Time}}&=\frac{\text{Area}}{\text{Time}}\times\frac{\text{Diesel}}{\text{Area}}\\\frac{x\text{ L}}{1\text{ h}}&=\frac{12\text{ ha}}{90\text{ min}}\times\frac{18\text{ L}}{1\text{ ha}}\\\frac{x\text{ L}}{1\text{ h}}&=\frac{12\text{ ha}}{(90\div60)\text{ h}}\times\frac{18\text{ L}}{1\text{ ha}}\\x&=8\times18\\x&=144\end{align*}$$
The tractor uses $144\text{ L/h}$.
